headline: Under Trump, ICE check-ins in Vermont have shifted
summary: In Vermont, under the Trump administration, ICE shifted from allowing virtual check-ins for immigrants awaiting deportation decisions to requiring in-person appointments at a single office in St. Albans, causing hardship and anxiety due to travel burdens and psychological stress. This change has not led to an increase in detentions at these appointments locally, but immigration advocates are concerned about language barriers during meetings and the lack of explanation for the policy shift.
